question: When is Raksha Bandhan celebrated in India as per the Hindu calendar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Poornima, Shravan month.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​Raksha Bandhan or Rakhi Purnima** is celebrated on the full moon day, or** Purnima tithi,** according to the **Hindu calendar.**
 
• It is observed during the **Shravana month.**
 
• **Hindus celebrate Raksha Bandhan** every year as a **well-known and customary ritual **or celebration.
 
• On this day, sisters of all ages wrap their** brothers' wrists with a charm** or **amulet** known as the Rakhi.
 
• They give them a present in exchange for** protecting them figuratively,** share some of the burdens of their **potential care with the brothers**, and symbolically **protect them.**
